notes.title: Play Scrap Galaxy online with Steam Remote Play Together!
notes.content:
Hello,

Jesper from Catalope Games here. Steam just added a new beta feature that allows you to play local multiplayer games online. It works via that the host streams the game to all clients and the clients send their input to the host. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31005580/941c24ffec0c86195e9fba8f3faab8e1dd7e2ad9.gif

This means you can play Scrap Galaxy with anyone in your Steam friend list... Providing that you all have a quite good connection and are around in the same part of world.

More information can be found here about Remote Play Together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31005580/9356fbe7212a1d4551c41e7ec5d55750a967c0f4.gif

How to play Scrap Galaxy with Remote Play Together?
Remote Play Together is a beta feature that require to be on the beta channel of Steam updates.

The host start Scrap Galaxy and open up their friend list. Right click on a friend then pick the "Invite to Remote Play Together" option. The friend accepts then you are both playing Scrap Galaxy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31005580/07f18551daf35f9d4772ff67628753660e2eb52a.gif

How to enable Steam beta?
Go to your Steam settings. In the Account tab, opt-in for Beta participation. Steam will then restart and you should be ready. Here is a tutorial covering the subject.

Let me know how it works for you in the forums or join our little Discord.
Jesper

notes.title: Scrap Galaxy patch v1.0.7
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31005580/17399099ce1225684b6f7801933899a81e57b8ab.png

Hi everyone!

Here are two patches (v1.0.7 and v1.0.6) that fixes some things requested by you the community. Firstly it adds a slider for how much the screen should shake when things are destroyed. Secondly it changes how sound is calculated, this makes the sound much more nice when there is a lot of bullets flying around.

Scrap Galaxy v1.0.7

    Add slider for screen shake amplitude.
    Change how sound intensity is handled.
 

If you've encountered any more bugs please let me know in the forums!

notes.title: Scrap Galaxy patch v1.0.5
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31005580/3588826a9b1ce1c5f12f47bf74fe1d433f39af85.png

Hi everyone!

Here is a small patch to fix some minor issues with the game. Mainly all co-op levels have been re balanced from Unity Analytic feedback. Some of them had some nasty difficulty spikes which should be fixed now. More descriptions have also been added to the main menu, hopefully fixing some confusion with what some of the options do.

Scrap Galaxy v1.0.5

    Rebalanced co-op levels.
    Fixed dialog box having wrong player color.
    Added description to main menu.
    Maybe fixed bug with round over and speed powerup.
 

If you've encountered any more bugs please let me know in the forums!

notes.title: Play Online with Parsec 🌟 Scrap Galaxy patch v1.0.3
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31005580/17399099ce1225684b6f7801933899a81e57b8ab.png

Hi! We have some really cool news to share with you. 

We have teamed up with Parsec to solve one of the most requested feature in Scrap Galaxy - Online multiplayer. Check the video below and go to parsecgaming.com to learn more. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=420ZpQts3cY
Since you are in fact streaming the entire game to the other players it works better the closer you are to each other geographically. Let us know how it works for you in the forums.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31005580/fae9cf88335b82d402a0e50c621630e304ed9ec4.png

Second update is that we have new art for the captains you play as. The designs are still very much the same, as we felt they matched the universe and tone quite well. But we now have a much more defined and polished style.

Scrap Galaxy patch v1.0.3

    Add new art and portrait for characters.
    Add --alwaysShowMouse parameter for MHOOK compability.

notes.title: Scrap Galaxy patch v1.0.2
notes.content:
Here is a patch fixing some bugs happening on rare occasions.

Scrap Galaxy v1.0.2

    Fix bug causing co-op levels to not progress if an AI is destroyed.
    AI spawn placement in co-op levels handles collisions better.
    Fixed bug caused by having a speed powerup while battle ending.
    Add 2 seconds of delay before spawn in boss run.
